base: branche de session (EMF1 pour les utilitaires) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Foggy Forest Base Camp, demande par l utilisateur
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip passe au generateur ; decor complet sur magenta (mare = magenta), herbe complete editee depuis le decor, planche de brume sur magenta

reference_da.titre: Camp de base de Foggy Forest (PMD Explorers)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Foggy Forest base camp): same pale mint-green short grass clearing, same darker striped green grass around, same beige-brown dirt path with ragged grass edges, same big round dark green trees with bright yellow-green highlights and brown roots, same pink Wigglytuff tents with ears and wooden stakes, same small pinkish-grey rocks and small dark green bushes, small flowers. Make a NEW, larger top-down map. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3, zoomed out so the area feels vast. Layout: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom edge center) on the dirt path; the path goes NORTH through a wide pale-green camp clearing with four pink tents spread around it, and continues north up to a dark shadowy opening between dense trees at the top center (the dungeon entrance). Dense trees fill the left and right sides and the top. A small calm pond on the right side of the clearing, away from the path. IMPORTANT: the pond water surface is filled with flat pure magenta #FF00FF, no ripples. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Same image, same size and pixel-art style, but showing only the plain pale mint-green short grass ground everywhere (trees, path, tents, rocks, bushes, cave and pink pond all removed and replaced by that same grass).

Pixel-art sprite sheet on a flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, in the style and soft colors of the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Foggy Forest). 2 rows of 4 separate soft pale white-green fog wisps / mist clouds, each a horizontally elongated puffy shape with a lighter core and dithered edges, different shapes. Sprites well separated with wide magenta spacing, no text, no grid lines.
generation.note: rendue en 4 rangees x 2 colonnes (896 x 1183) : poses extraites par composantes

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne
fidelite_rip.note: le generateur a rendu une scene plus claire et laiteuse que le rip (voile de brume) : ecarts plus grands que sur les lots precedents, non corriges pour ne pas recolorer

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

segmentation: eau = magenta et frange rosee dilates 3 px ; grotte = bouche sombre (lum<100, sat<30) et pierre grise peu saturee a <= 40 px, zone haut-centre ; chemin = beige (r-b>22, |r-g|<22), grande composante ; tentes = roses (r>g+25) >= 2500 px + boite de chaque tente hors herbe pale ; rochers = roses < 2500 px + anneau d ombre ; herbe du camp = lum lissee > 168 et g-r lisse > 18 reliee au chemin ; buissons = trous fermes sombres > 150 px et iles sombres isolees ; arbres = g-r lisse 11 px < 42 ; sous-bois = le reste

water.modele: structure et cadence riviere Metano, couleurs Metano EXACTES, sans liseré de rive (water_phases d EWC2)
water.origine: pixels recalcules, pas de tuiles natives

sparkles.origine: pixels et couleurs Metano NATIFS inchanges (aplat de surface retire)

brume.derive: x0 + 20 sin(2 pi t/48 + phi), y0 + 3 sin(4 pi t/48 + 2 phi)
brume.trame: damier fixe sur la carte ((x+y) pair), alpha 0/255 uniquement (pas de translucidite a premultiplier)
brume.origine: dessin GENERE ; derive, trame et boucle creees par nous (pas une animation officielle)

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors herbe du camp et chemin
access.seuil: devant la bouche de la grotte, au nord
